instruction: A candid family photograph in a medium shot captures an outdoor scene in a grassy park with blurred trees. In the center, the man in the white hoodie (R2) faces forward with a wide smile, carrying the baby girl in denim overalls (R1) on his shoulders. The baby girl (R1), wearing a pink fleece jacket, laughs joyfully with her arms raised. On the right, the woman in the black leather jacket (R3) stands in profile, smiling up at them and raising her left hand to touch the baby's hand. The man (R2) holds the baby's legs for support. Soft, natural daylight casts a gentle glow over the warm, autumnal setting.
